int_name: W DAUPHIN ST & N HOWARD ST

result.summary: The street environment features narrow sidewalks and a single travel lane, which may naturally calm traffic, but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signs visible at the intersection, creating a high-exposure environment for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space or priority for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the sidewalk inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection in the foreground

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a two-lane urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a marked zebra crosswalk in the foreground. Pedestrian safety is limited by the lack of traffic control devices and significant visual obstructions caused by vehicles parked directly adjacent to the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street at the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the marked pedestrian crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large black bins or containers are placed on the narrow sidewalk on the right side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Refresh the faded crosswalk and lane markings to improve driver awareness.
